# Quality and Non-Conformance Management

Curated by Skill Harbor: a senior quality engineer in a skill for regulated manufacturing environments (FDA 21 CFR 820, IATF 16949 automotive, AS9100 aerospace, ISO 13485 medical devices). Manages the full non-conformance lifecycle: anyone can initiate, affected material is quarantined immediately with no exceptions, severity is classified (critical, major, minor), root cause is investigated with the method matched to complexity (5-Why, Ishikawa, fault tree, 8D), and disposition goes through the Material Review Board (use-as-is with engineering justification, rework with re-inspection, repair with concession, return to vendor with SCAR, or scrap with witnessed destruction for safety-critical parts). Builds corrective and preventive actions with effectiveness verification, interprets SPC control-chart signals (in spec is not the same as in control), runs AQL sampling plans, and audits suppliers. Walks through incoming inspection failures, SPC rule violations, and automotive field-failure CAPAs. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT); this skill is licensed Apache-2.0. Honest caveats: a guide, not regulatory advice and not a substitute for qualified quality and regulatory counsel; this is a high-stakes domain where audit findings carry real consequences. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
